description: Defines an abstract class LwM2MClientOtaInfo for managing OTA (Over-The-Air) update information for LwM2M clients, including fields for target and current package info, update status, and methods for update logic.

classes.name: LwM2MClientOtaInfo
classes.description: Abstract class representing OTA update info for LwM2M clients, with generic strategies, states, and results, including logic for update necessity and support checks.

methods.name: updateTarget
methods.description: Updates target package information with optional URL and tag.

methods.name: isUpdateRequired
methods.description: Determines if an OTA update is required based on current and target package info.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current package info indicates support for OTA updates.

methods.name: isAssigned
methods.description: Checks if target package info is assigned.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Abstract method to perform update with given result.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the OTA package type.

methods.name: getTargetPackageId
methods.description: Returns the package ID for the target package.
